name: Yarzion Vell's home planet
description: A terrestrial planet was the homeworld of the Jedi Yarzion Vell, a member of a humanoid species. By 230 BBY, when Vell was a Padawan, he returned to his home planet on a mission and had himself tattooed with the name of his Jedi Master, Lulad, in accordance with the planet's tradition. When she learned what he had done, she had Vell's name tattooed on her head. Vell later mentioned his home planet and its tradition to Jedi Master Kelnacca, who took over Vell's training after Lulad's death, and to his own Padawan, Ordea.
